description: Manage temporary and permanent media, article drafts, publishing, and reader statistics, and send customer service, mass, and template messages for a WeChat Official Account through the WeChat Official Account Platform APIs. The runtime's public egress IP must be added to the account's API IP whitelist in the 微信开发者平台 console (公众号 → 基础信息 → 开发密钥 → API IP白名单), otherwise every call fails with errcode 40164.

auth.description: Add this runtime's public egress IP to the account's API IP whitelist in the 微信开发者平台 console (公众号 → 基础信息 → 开发密钥 → API IP白名单) before connecting, otherwise every API call fails with errcode 40164.

fields.label: AppID
fields.description: The AppID of the WeChat Official Account. Find it in the 微信开发者平台 console under 公众号 → 基础信息 → 开发密钥.

fields.label: AppSecret
fields.description: The AppSecret of the same WeChat Official Account. Copy it from the 微信开发者平台 console under 公众号 → 基础信息 → 开发密钥.

actions.name: add_draft
actions.description: Create an article draft with 1 to 8 articles. Cover images must be permanent material media_ids.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

articleType.description: The article type; set to `newspic` for a picture message. Omit for a regular news article.

digest.description: The article digest shown in the article list.

content.description: The article HTML content. Image URLs inside must come from upload_article_image.

contentSourceUrl.description: The original URL linked by the read-more button.

thumbMediaId.description: The media_id of the cover image permanent material.

thumbUrl.description: The cover image URL, used instead of thumbMediaId for `newspic` articles.

onlyFansCanComment.description: Whether only followers can comment: 0 or 1.

imageInfo.description: The image_info payload passed through to WeChat.

coverInfo.description: The cover_info payload passed through to WeChat.

productInfo.description: The product_info payload passed through to WeChat.

items.description: One draft article. Known fields are camelCase here and are sent to WeChat in snake_case; any additional field is passed through unchanged.

articles.description: The draft articles, in display order.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response carrying the draft media_id.

actions.name: add_material
actions.description: Upload a permanent media material. Permanent materials do not expire but count toward the account material quota. Size limits: image 10 MB, voice 2 MB, video 10 MB, thumb 64 KB. Video uploads require title and introduction.
providerPermissions: Upload permanent materials to the connected WeChat Official Account

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: The media file previously uploaded to the local transit file API.

title.description: The video title. Required when type is video.

introduction.description: The video introduction. Required when type is video.

media_id.description: The media_id of the uploaded permanent material.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat permanent material upload response.

actions.name: add_template
actions.description: Add a private template from the template library by its short id and get back the full template_id. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

templateIdShort.description: The template_id_short from the public template library.

template_id.description: The full template_id created from the short id.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response carrying the new template_id.

actions.name: batch_get_draft
actions.description: List article drafts in pages of at most 20 items.

offset.description: The zero-based offset of the first item to return. Defaults to 0.

count.description: The number of items to return, between 1 and 20. Defaults to 20.

noContent.description: Whether to omit the article content field from the returned items. Defaults to false.

item_count.description: The number of drafts in this page.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat draft page.

actions.name: batch_get_material
actions.description: List permanent materials of one type in pages of at most 20 items.

offset.description: The zero-based offset of the first item to return. Defaults to 0.

count.description: The number of items to return, between 1 and 20. Defaults to 20.

inputSchema.description: The permanent material page to list.

total_count.description: The total number of materials of this type.

item_count.description: The number of materials in this page.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat permanent material page.

actions.name: batch_get_published
actions.description: List successfully published article records in pages of at most 20 items.

offset.description: The zero-based offset of the first item to return. Defaults to 0.

count.description: The number of items to return, between 1 and 20. Defaults to 20.

noContent.description: Whether to omit the article content field from the returned items. Defaults to false.

inputSchema.description: The published article page to list.

total_count.description: The total number of publish records.

item_count.description: The number of publish records in this page.

item.description: The publish records in this page.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat published article page.

actions.name: callback_check
actions.description: Check network connectivity between WeChat servers and the callback URL configured for the official account. Fails with errcode 40201 when the account has no callback URL configured.

checkOperator.description: The carrier line to check from.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat callback check result.

actions.name: clear_quota
actions.description: Reset the monthly API call quota of the connected official account. The account's appId is taken from the credential. Each account can clear its quota at most 10 times per calendar month.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: delete_draft
actions.description: Permanently delete one article draft by media_id. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

mediaId.description: The media_id of the draft to delete.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: delete_mass_message
actions.description: Delete a mass-sent message by msg_id. articleIdx selects one article inside the message, counting from 1; omit it to delete the whole message. Only messages sent through the API that finished sending can be deleted, and only news and video messages qualify. Deletion invalidates the article content page for everyone; users who already received the message still see its card locally. When several mass sends shared one article, deleting one send invalidates all of them.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

anyOf.description: The msg_id returned by send_mass_message or send_mass_message_by_tag.
The msg_id returned by send_mass_message or send_mass_message_by_tag.

msgId.description: The msg_id returned by send_mass_message or send_mass_message_by_tag.

articleIdx.description: The 1-based index of the article inside the message. Omit to delete all articles.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: delete_material
actions.description: Permanently delete a permanent material by media_id. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Delete permanent materials from the connected WeChat Official Account

mediaId.description: The media_id of the permanent material to delete.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: delete_publish
actions.description: Delete a published article by article_id. index selects one article inside the published message, counting from 1; omit index to delete the whole message. Deleted articles show as unavailable to readers. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Delete published articles of the connected WeChat Official Account

articleId.description: The article_id of the published message to delete.

index.description: The 1-based index of the article inside the message. Omit to delete all articles.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: delete_template
actions.description: Delete one private template by template_id. Only certified service accounts can use this API. This cannot be undone.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

templateId.description: The template_id of the private template to delete.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: get_all_templates
actions.description: List all private templates of the account. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

template_list.description: The private templates of the account.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat private template list.

actions.name: get_api_domain_ip
actions.description: Get the WeChat API server IP addresses that the official account servers may call from.

items.description: One IP address or CIDR range.

ip_list.description: The IP addresses reported by WeChat.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response with the requested IP list.

actions.name: get_article_read
actions.description: Get the daily read metrics of every published article that was read on the given day. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 1 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

beginDate.description: The first date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The last date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest.

is_delay.description: Whether WeChat marked the returned data as delayed.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat statistics response.

actions.name: get_article_share
actions.description: Get the daily share metrics of every published article that was shared on the given day. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 1 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

beginDate.description: The first date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The last date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest.

is_delay.description: Whether WeChat marked the returned data as delayed.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat statistics response.

actions.name: get_article_total_detail
actions.description: Get the cumulative per-article metrics for everything published in the range. Each article accumulates at most 30 days of data from its publish date. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 1 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

beginDate.description: The first date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The last date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest.

is_delay.description: Whether WeChat marked the returned data as delayed.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat statistics response.

actions.name: get_biz_summary
actions.description: Get the per-day overview metrics aggregated across all content published in the range. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 30 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

beginDate.description: The first date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The last date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest.

is_delay.description: Whether WeChat marked the returned data as delayed.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat statistics response.

actions.name: get_callback_ip
actions.description: Get the WeChat callback server IP addresses. Allowlist them when the official account receives message callbacks.

items.description: One IP address or CIDR range.

ip_list.description: The IP addresses reported by WeChat.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response with the requested IP list.

actions.name: get_draft
actions.description: Get the content of one article draft by media_id.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat draft content.

actions.name: get_draft_count
actions.description: Get the total number of article drafts of the official account.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat draft count.

actions.name: get_mass_message_status
actions.description: Poll the send status of a mass message task by msg_id.

anyOf.description: The msg_id returned by send_mass_message or send_mass_message_by_tag.
The msg_id returned by send_mass_message or send_mass_message_by_tag.

msgId.description: The msg_id returned by send_mass_message or send_mass_message_by_tag.

inputSchema.description: The mass message task to poll.

msg_status.description: The task status: SEND_SUCCESS, SENDING, SEND_FAIL, or DELETE.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat mass send status.

actions.name: get_material
actions.description: Get a permanent material by media_id. News materials return their articles and video materials return title, description, and down_url as JSON; image and voice materials are stored in local transit storage.
providerPermissions: Download permanent materials from the connected WeChat Official Account

mediaId.description: The media_id of the permanent material.

fileName.description: An optional file name override for binary downloads.

contentType.description: The downloaded media content type (binary downloads only).

file.description: The downloaded media stored in local transit storage.

video_url.description: The video playback URL (temporary video media only).

news_item.description: The articles of a permanent news material.

title.description: The video title (permanent video material only).

description.description: The video description (permanent video material only).

down_url.description: The video download URL (permanent video material only).

outputSchema.description: A JSON payload for news or video media, or the downloaded file for binary media. Only one branch's fields are present.

actions.name: get_material_count
actions.description: Get the permanent material counts of the official account, grouped by media type.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat permanent material counts.

actions.name: get_publish_status
actions.description: Poll the status of a publish task by publish_id.
providerPermissions: Publish article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

publish_status.description: The publish status: 0 succeeded, 1 publishing, 2/3/4 failed, 5/6 deleted or blocked after success.

article_id.description: The published article_id when publish_status is 0.

article_detail.description: The published article details when publish_status is 0.

fail_idx.description: The 1-based indexes of the articles that failed.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat publish task status.

actions.name: get_published_article
actions.description: Get the content of a published article by article_id.

articleId.description: The article_id returned when the publish task succeeded.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat published article content.

actions.name: get_temp_media
actions.description: Download a temporary media file by media_id. Image, voice, and thumb media are stored in local transit storage; video media returns a video_url instead.
providerPermissions: Download temporary media from the connected WeChat Official Account

mediaId.description: The media_id returned by upload_temp_media or a message.

fileName.description: An optional file name override for the downloaded media.

contentType.description: The downloaded media content type (binary downloads only).

file.description: The downloaded media stored in local transit storage.

video_url.description: The video playback URL (temporary video media only).

news_item.description: The articles of a permanent news material.

title.description: The video title (permanent video material only).

description.description: The video description (permanent video material only).

down_url.description: The video download URL (permanent video material only).

outputSchema.description: A JSON payload for news or video media, or the downloaded file for binary media. Only one branch's fields are present.

actions.name: get_template_industry
actions.description: Get the primary and secondary industry currently set on the account. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

primary_industry.description: The primary industry, with first_class and second_class names.

secondary_industry.description: The secondary industry, with first_class and second_class names.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat template industry settings.

actions.name: get_user_cumulate
actions.description: Get the per-day cumulative follower count of the official account. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 7 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

beginDate.description: The first date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The last date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest.

is_delay.description: Whether WeChat marked the returned data as delayed.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat statistics response.

actions.name: get_user_summary
actions.description: Get per-day follower gains and losses of the official account. Both dates use YYYY-MM-DD, and WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest. The range spans at most 7 day(s) including both ends. Only certified WeChat Official Accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Read WeChat Official Account analytics (certified accounts only)

beginDate.description: The first date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The last date of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. WeChat returns data up to yesterday at the latest.

is_delay.description: Whether WeChat marked the returned data as delayed.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat statistics response.

actions.name: preview_mass_message
actions.description: Preview a mass message to one follower before sending, to check its style and layout. Only certified accounts can use this API. Previewing by WeChat ID (toWxName) is limited to 100 calls per day.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

toUser.description: The OpenID of the follower to preview to. Exactly one of toUser and toWxName is required.

toWxName.description: The WeChat ID of the user to preview to. Exactly one of toUser and toWxName is required.

content.description: The content object for the chosen msgType, sent under the msgtype key itself. Shapes: mpnews {media_id}; text {content}; voice {media_id}; music {media_id}; image {media_id}; mpvideo {media_id, title?, description?}; wxcard {card_id, card_ext?}. Note the preview image content takes a single media_id, unlike the media_ids list used by the mass send actions.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: publish_draft
actions.description: Submit one article draft for publishing. The returned publish_id only means the publish task was accepted; poll get_publish_status for the result. Only certified accounts can publish.
providerPermissions: Publish article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

mediaId.description: The media_id of the draft to publish.

publish_id.description: The publish task id used to poll the publish status.

msg_data_id.description: The message data id of the published article.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat publish task response.

actions.name: send_custom_message
actions.description: Send a customer service message to one follower. Only certified accounts can use this API, and the follower must have interacted with the account within the last 48 hours. content is the message-type-specific object documented per msgType.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

toUser.description: The OpenID of the follower to message.

content.description: The content object for the chosen msgType, passed through as the message body. Shapes: text {content}; image/voice {media_id}; video {media_id, thumb_media_id, title, description}; music {title, description, musicurl, hqmusicurl, thumb_media_id}; news {articles: [{title, description, url, picurl}]}; mpnews {media_id}; mpnewsarticle {article_id}; wxcard {card_id}; miniprogrampage {title, appid, pagepath, thumb_media_id}; msgmenu {head_content, list: [{id, content}], tail_content}.

inputSchema.description: The customer service message to send.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: send_mass_message
actions.description: Mass-send a message to a list of follower OpenIDs (between 2 and 10000). Only certified accounts can mass-send: certified subscription accounts once per day, certified service accounts 4 times per calendar month. A successful response only means the task was accepted; poll get_mass_message_status for the result.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

content.description: The content object for the chosen msgType. Shapes: mpnews {media_id} (a draft or permanent news material media_id); text {content}; voice {media_id}; image {media_ids: [...], recommend?, title?, need_open_comment?, only_fans_can_comment?}; mpvideo {media_id, title?, description?}; wxcard {card_id}.

sendIgnoreReprint.description: For mpnews only: whether to continue sending when the article is judged a reprint. Defaults to false (stop sending).

msg_id.description: The mass send task id used to poll or delete the task.

msg_data_id.description: The message data id, returned for news (mpnews) messages only.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat mass send response.

actions.name: send_mass_message_by_tag
actions.description: Mass-send a message to all followers or to one follower tag. Only certified accounts can mass-send: certified subscription accounts once per day, certified service accounts 4 times per calendar month. A successful response only means the task was accepted; poll get_mass_message_status for the result.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

isToAll.description: Whether to send to all followers. Defaults to false.

tagId.description: The tag id to send to. Required when isToAll is false. Ignored when isToAll is true.

content.description: The content object for the chosen msgType. Shapes: mpnews {media_id} (a draft or permanent news material media_id); text {content}; voice {media_id}; image {media_ids: [...], recommend?, title?, need_open_comment?, only_fans_can_comment?}; mpvideo {media_id, title?, description?}; wxcard {card_id}.

msg_id.description: The mass send task id used to poll or delete the task.

msg_data_id.description: The message data id, returned for news (mpnews) messages only.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat mass send response.

actions.name: send_template_message
actions.description: Send a template message to one follower. Only certified service accounts can use this API. data maps each template keyword to {value, color?}.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

toUser.description: The OpenID of the follower to message.

templateId.description: The template_id of a private template of the account.

url.description: An optional URL opened when the follower taps the message.

miniprogram.description: An optional mini program jump target with appid and pagepath.

clientMsgId.description: An optional caller-side id (at most 32 bytes) that deduplicates retries.

data.description: The template data, mapping each keyword to {value, color?}.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat template message response.

actions.name: set_template_industry
actions.description: Set the primary and secondary industry of the account, which decides which template library entries are available. Only certified service accounts can use this API.
providerPermissions: Manage message templates of the connected WeChat Official Account

industryId1.description: The primary industry id from the WeChat template industry table.

industryId2.description: The secondary industry id from the WeChat template industry table.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: set_typing_status
actions.description: Show or hide the customer service typing indicator for one follower. Only certified accounts can use this API, and the follower must have interacted with the account within the last 48 hours.
providerPermissions: Send messages to followers of the connected WeChat Official Account

command.description: Whether to start or stop typing.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: update_draft
actions.description: Replace one article inside a draft. index is zero-based: the first article is 0.
providerPermissions: Manage article drafts of the connected WeChat Official Account

mediaId.description: The media_id of the draft to update.

index.description: The zero-based index of the article inside the draft.

articleType.description: The article type; set to `newspic` for a picture message. Omit for a regular news article.

digest.description: The article digest shown in the article list.

content.description: The article HTML content. Image URLs inside must come from upload_article_image.

contentSourceUrl.description: The original URL linked by the read-more button.

thumbMediaId.description: The media_id of the cover image permanent material.

thumbUrl.description: The cover image URL, used instead of thumbMediaId for `newspic` articles.

onlyFansCanComment.description: Whether only followers can comment: 0 or 1.

imageInfo.description: The image_info payload passed through to WeChat.

coverInfo.description: The cover_info payload passed through to WeChat.

productInfo.description: The product_info payload passed through to WeChat.

article.description: One draft article. Known fields are camelCase here and are sent to WeChat in snake_case; any additional field is passed through unchanged.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat response. It carries no fields on success.

actions.name: upload_article_image
actions.description: Upload an image used inside article HTML content and get back its WeChat-hosted URL. Only the returned URL renders inside article content. JPG/PNG only, at most 1 MB. Does not consume the material quota.
providerPermissions: Upload article images to the connected WeChat Official Account

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: The JPG or PNG image previously uploaded to the local transit file API.

url.description: The WeChat-hosted image URL to embed in article content.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat article image upload response.

actions.name: upload_temp_media
actions.description: Upload a temporary media file to the official account. Temporary media expires 3 days after upload. Size limits: image 10 MB, voice 2 MB, video 10 MB, thumb 64 KB.
providerPermissions: Upload temporary media to the connected WeChat Official Account

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: The media file previously uploaded to the local transit file API.

type.description: The media type echoed by WeChat.

media_id.description: The media_id of the uploaded temporary media, valid for 3 days.

created_at.description: The upload time as a Unix timestamp.

outputSchema.description: The upstream WeChat temporary media upload response.
